Legal Advice
Know Your Rights

Every citizen in Uganda is protected under the 1995 Constitution.

Common Legal Questions

Most common issues include land disputes, domestic violence, employment termination.

AI Legal Guidance

This system provides preliminary legal guidance only. It is not a substitute for a lawyer.

Legal Templates

Standard documents include tenancy agreements, affidavit forms, complaint letters.

Find Help
Find A Lawyer

Connect with registered advocates licensed by the Uganda Law Society.

Legal Aid Providers

Free or low-cost legal help is available through legal aid clinics and NGOs.

Local Council Offices

LC1 and LC2 offices handle neighborhood disputes and minor debt recovery.

Emergency Support

Contact Uganda Police Force or legal emergency hotlines immediately.

Welcome

The Local Council Digital Justice Platform connects citizens to community justice services, legal information and support.

Report disputes, seek legal guidance, track your cases and connect with community leaders and justice partners.

How We Can Help You
⚖️

Report Case

Submit disputes and complaints for local review.

📂

🎓

Learn your rights, responsibilities, and local laws.
